description: This file defines a TRPC router for managing permissions, roles, and PBAC (Policy-Based Access Control) features within a team or organization. It includes procedures for checking permissions, creating, updating, deleting roles, and enabling PBAC for an organization.

methods.name: getUserPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for the authenticated user.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission within a team.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the user has multiple permissions within a team.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new role within a team after permission validation.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates an existing role's permissions and attributes after permission validation.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role within a team after permission validation.

methods.name: getTeamRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles for a team, with special handling if PBAC is not enabled.

methods.name: enablePbac
methods.description: Enables PBAC feature for the user's organization if authorized.
